_note: Numbers measured from v13-tickets.html (the golden CSS) and HANDOFF.md section 3-6. Checks read these, not the mock's pixels. Container queries decide the stub side, so card measurements are taken per card, never per viewport.

card._horizontalStubMinPx: This is the horizontal stub's MIN HEIGHT (min-height: 300px), not its width; the width is --stub (stubHeightPx 168, sessionStubHeightPx 150). Fixed 2026-10-17 after the check measured width against it.

stubPhotoRule: An inside [data-ticket-stub] is a third image role beside the hero photo and the long-form break. It is allowed only on the ticket routes (/national-show/tickets, /national-show/conferences, /national-show/workshops, /tickets/), only the file v13-photo-map.json assigns that product, alt empty, and never anywhere else on the site.
sampleNumbersBanned: Places left are sample numbers for this design.

dayPassFrom.note: R30 (1): under the hub hero CTAs; amount = the effective price of the Day Pass card (builder output dayPassFrom, resolveEffectivePrice, never an expired early bird); not rendered when null (R7).

closeBand.label: Tickets
closeBand.note: RETIRED by design-cb's final ruling (P1-2): v13 has NO closing band on /national-show/tickets (masthead, thursday, passes, programme, sessions) and a band there would link the page to itself. A31 asserts the selector is ABSENT. The selector is kept only so the check can find a regression. Former note: R30 (2) closing band from the existing CtaBand.

motion.rule: R84, the single motion exception to R28 on NOS routes. Only these three, every one inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) (or a motion-safe: class): the hero fan-out once on load (keyframes fan-out for the arc and fan-up for the 2x2 deck, 1.1s, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)), the ticket hover lift (translateY(-5px), 360ms), the button press (scale(0.98)). Reduced motion shows the final fanned state. No other @keyframes or animation on NOS.

palette.note: Audit checklist field colours. Hex lives ONLY in a lib/data/*.ts constant (passed to the components as inline style vars): A10 forbids hex in components and CSS and allows only these seven in lib/. rgba only on drop-shadow / --t-rule / --t-edge, inside the keepsake paths. Shadows are filter: drop-shadow, never box-shadow.
